items.raw_claim: Cloudflare Python Workers are generally available with native bindings to D1, R2 and Workers AI.

items.raw_claim: MiMo V2.6 Pro/Flash/UltraSpeed are available on Vercel AI Gateway with 1M context and 128K max output.
items.summary: Xiaomi's MiMo V2.6 family is available on Vercel AI Gateway: Pro (1.02T total / 42B active MoE), Flash (309B / 15B active) and Pro UltraSpeed (claimed up to 20x output speed). All have a 1M-token context, up to 128K output tokens, structured outputs and multimodal input. Latent Space reports Pro as the new top open-weights model, trained for about $3M. If you route agent or coding work through a gateway, it costs little to add as a candidate and benchmark against your current default.
items.title: Xiaomi MiMo V2.6 (Pro, Flash, UltraSpeed) now callable via Vercel AI Gateway
items.uncertainty: Quality and "top open weights" ranking are vendor/newsletter claims; no independent reproducible evals seen; pricing not in snippet.
items.verdict_reason: Best of three sources on the same model release; concrete availability details.
items.worth_mentioning_reason: A new open-weights frontier-class option with long context for agent work, available through one API today.

items.raw_claim: n8n 2.40.5 and 2.39.10 backport a fix limiting declarative routing during base URL ownership checks.
items.summary: n8n shipped same-day patch releases on both the 2.40 and 2.39 lines with one fix: "Limit declarative routing during base URL ownership checks". A single-fix backport to two release lines usually means a security hardening fix, probably around request routing or SSRF. If you self-host n8n, update to 2.40.5, 2.39.10 or 2.41.0.
items.title: n8n 2.40.5 / 2.39.10: backported fix limiting declarative routing during base-URL ownership checks
items.uncertainty: No advisory/CVE linked; security impact is inferred from the backport pattern.
items.verdict_reason: Narrow but actionable for self-hosters; representative of four duplicate n8n release entries.
items.worth_mentioning_reason: Possible security fix for a commonly self-hosted automation tool; cheap to patch.

items.raw_claim: Vercel now exposes per-deployment billable duration and CPU minutes via dashboard, CLI and REST API.

items.title: Deployments now show billable duration and CPU minutes
items.verdict_reason: Useful cost tooling, narrow to Vercel users.
items.worth_mentioning_reason: Direct cost visibility for Vercel users.

items.raw_claim: Vercel Connect adds a managed Microsoft Teams bot connector with no client secret to store.
items.summary: Vercel Connect now has a managed Microsoft Teams connector. Vercel registers the Entra app and Azure Bot in your tenant, so you don't have to store a client secret, and forwards verified Teams messages to your project so an agent can reply as a bot. This lowers the effort of shipping an agent into enterprise Teams channels, a possible distribution route for B2B agent products.
items.title: Vercel Connect now supports Microsoft Teams
items.uncertainty: Requires a tenant admin with an Azure subscription; pricing not stated.
items.worth_mentioning_reason: Shortcut to Teams distribution for agent products.
